actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA proliferation identity (E2F/G2M up) with directionally consistent genomic trends, stable internal structure (ARI 0.667) and positive fused boundaries. The CT scanner-model association does not explain the RNA/WXS/CNV signals, so no material unresolved question requires further evidence.

C0002 has affirmative multimodal identity (PBRM1-mutant, VHL-associated, BAP1-wildtype, low CNV burden, WNT/angiogenesis up) with stable structure and strong genomic/transcriptomic boundaries. Technical CT-field associations are concerning for CT-derived structure but do not explain the defining genomic signal, so the candidate remains defensible for downstream validation.

C0003 has strong coherent identity (BAP1 enrichment q=7e-08, PBRM1 depletion, interferon/inflammatory program), stable internal structure (ARI 0.602), strong WXS boundary separation, and no technical confounding.

C0004 lacks a coherent distinguishing molecular signature: no significant RNA, WXS, or CNV signal, only a nominal VHL trend, and weak cross-modal membership support (median 1 modality, one patient with none). No structural revision resolves this absence of identity evidence.

C0005 has affirmative CNV-defined identity (retained 3p/VHL/PBRM1/SETD2/BAP1, depleted mutation, suppressed hypoxia/immune programs) with directionally consistent RNA/WXS trends and no technical confounding. Internal structure is weak but boundaries are positive, so it remains defensible for downstream validation.

C0006 has a coherent metabolic/adipogenic transcriptional identity with suggestive genomic trends and no technical confounding. Cross-modal membership support and internal structure are weak, but no available evidence indicates a better-supported structural revision, so it remains a defensible discovery-stage candidate.
